# Wave022 FIRST — cutoff inclusion is a two-boundary contract

Independent FIRST, featuresB; no peer022 read or helpers. Official source reading only; no package/data/model/Y/native/fit/experiment/project work. **Zero novel mechanisms/HYPs:** refine existing HYP002/TLAB016 temporal adapter contract and rounds013/025/043. Current015/018/native-parameterV2 review remain separate, with no new dependency or gate.

**Primary facts.** Featuretools1.31.0 Handling Time documents `include_cutoff_time=True` as default. With a training window, it includes the cutoff and excludes the oldest boundary; `False` excludes the cutoff and includes the oldest boundary. Thus its illustrated intervals are `(t−W,t]` versus `[t−W,t)`, not merely two upper-edge choices. The guide defines time index as when row information became known; naming REES46 event_time does not prove ingestion availability. [Official guide, excluding cutoff times](https://docs.featuretools.com/en/stable/getting_started/handling_time.html#excluding-data-at-cutoff-times).

Independent author-source inspection corroborates primary predicates `<=t`/`<t` and `>t−W`/`>=t−W`. It also ORs the lower-window mask with `last_time_index` when supplied. Therefore the simple interval statement is scoped to primary time-index filtering without that extra retention path, not every parent/child relation. Mutable main was inspected at blob99847252646854c4afa2f745c53d3fafe4cc876d; it is not claimed to be the documentation's release. [Author source, lines1411–1455](https://github.com/alteryx/featuretools/blob/main/featuretools/entityset/entityset.py).

**Mechanism/refinement.** A future backend binding for our human-bounded generator must preserve the **paired endpoint predicate and per-leaf history extent**, not translate only “24h” or a word “cutoff.” Existing005 count leaves require `[max(S,t−W),t)`; recency uses the full observed prefix. Record the verified backend mapping/proof scope in the existing temporal signature/lineage. Do not silently replace that mapping with library defaults, one global window, approximation or an entity's last-time eligibility. This is contract clarification, not a proposed new planner or library integration.

**Prediction.** Default inclusion can reverse which of a lower-bound event and a same-time peer contributes. Explicit `False` matches our two count endpoints in the scoped flat case, but cannot alone establish equivalent relational availability, full-prefix recency, NULL behavior or physical companions. No aggregation-NULL/default-value equivalence is claimed from these sources.

**Nearest finite UNRUN experiment / strong simple control.** At most8 invented event rows, two candidate keys and one anchor: put one item's event exactly at t−24h and another's exactly at t; add a strict interior row, duplicate, future suffix and an8-day-old purchase. Compare keyed expected inclusion/recency against unchanged005 semantics and an independent list specification. Default closed-upper/excluded-lower and a globally truncated recency branch are fault controls, not quality baselines. Keep source bounds, raw multiplicity, global peer policy, complete keys/masks/support closure and metadata buckets fixed. No library execution is needed for this first specification check, and none ran here.

**Task1 benefit / cost / negative criterion.** This prevents an apparently compatible cutoff adapter from changing generated-feature meaning while retaining the bounded human design. Future-only one-attempt ceiling15CPU/30wall seconds,128MiB, all preparation/comparisons/failures/cleanup paid;0SQL/native/models/fits/Y, ungranted. Any endpoint, old-recency, key or closure mismatch rejects the binding; a finite pass supports only those tested semantics, not throughput/ranking or general Featuretools parity. No current pool, operator, fit allowance or mandatory prerequisite changes.

# Wave022 — a restricted DFS countercontrol, not another search

Independent FIRST, 15 October 2026; peer022 unread. **Zero new mechanisms/IDs.** Existing016 typed generation,018 conformance, HYP046 calculation and rounds026/029/030 already cover this family. No dependency, experiment, gate, grant or quality claim is added. Current B/W/final stay frozen;015 CLOSED and018 work retain priority.

**Fresh primary facts.** The served official stable documentation identifies Featuretools1.31.0; this is a documentation observation, not a claim about an installed runtime. DFS accepts explicit relationships, primitive/column/path restrictions, depth limits, manually supplied seed features, and definition-only generation. Its default feature-count cap is unlimited. These are controls on enumeration; the API does not establish superiority of the generated features. [Official DFS API](https://docs.featuretools.com/en/stable/generated/featuretools.dfs.html)

The documented time index means when a row's information became usable. Default cutoff includes events at t; `include_cutoff_time=False` gives the event-window endpoints [t−h,t). A secondary index can delay individual columns. Approximation deliberately reuses aggregate values across cutoff buckets, so it is inappropriate as an exact temporal-parity control. [Official time guide](https://docs.featuretools.com/en/stable/getting_started/handling_time.html)

The published `_handle_time` code applies `<t` with cutoff exclusion, `>=t−h` at the lower bound, and masks secondary-index columns when their secondary clock is `>=t`. This is source inspection only. It does not invent missing availability clocks or restore overwritten historical metadata. The latter is an inference from the filtering/masking operation, not a promised library feature. [Official code](https://docs.featuretools.com/en/stable/_modules/featuretools/entityset/entityset.html#EntitySet._handle_time)

**Mechanism / strongest countercontrol.** Describe a restricted DFS-style enumerator given exactly our human-declared roles, relationships, actions,24/168h windows and primitive whitelist. Normalize its definitions to the existing typed AST; compare semantic signatures and complete emitted physical closure, not names or a cap of “three logical features”. Preserve raw event duplicates with separate row keys, exact distinct/NULL rules, all global peers before candidate projection and the same Q/C population. Seed B41 and exclude its exact aliases. Unrestricted defaults would change information, search opportunities and calculation cost. This is an information-equivalent construction countercontrol, not an actual Featuretools runtime benchmark or a new model arm.

**Prediction.** On the overlapping aggregation grammar, equivalent explicit definitions should carry the same information and scalar values. Differences should expose endpoint, relationship, NULL or availability contracts before any learner comparison. No residual quality difference can be attributed to “automatic aggregation” merely because two enumerators produced different feature names. REES46 has an event clock but no independent arrival clock in the allowed fields: replay availability remains an explicit assumption, not a causal guarantee.

**Nearest single UNRUN finite experiment.** If later useful, compare three already-supported programs—raw cart count24h, distinct viewers24h and cart recency with its companion/missing fields—against independent hand definitions of the restricted contract. Use at most12 invented event rows, two anchors and16 predeclared scalar/closure assertions. Include both endpoints, duplicate/NULL projections and a declared unavailable-field example. That availability example tests the stated contract only; it cannot certify real ingestion delays. First unequal value/closure or unsupported clock binding falsifies claimed equivalence. Exact agreement is a valid negative result: no new information mechanism established. No Featuretools installation or framework execution is required for this contract comparison.

**Task1 benefit / cost.** This makes manual assumptions and the actual contribution legible while preserving the frozen quality study. Optional future cap: ≤30CPU/60wall seconds,128MiB,12 records,16 assertions,0 real scans/fits/predictions/metric looks; case design, reference evaluation, failures and review share that cap. No test was run here. Full DFS integration/preparation is unmeasured and deferred; it cannot receive free setup or replace mandatory015/018.
